R0_exception.exact_layout: new R0 file bound by P; canonical envelope as recorded

common.absent_records: Use an explicit stage-bound ABSENT or NOT_APPLICABLE disposition with reason and actor evidence; do not invent an approval or a digest of a future artifact.

body_common_fields.dependencies: exact role-keyed map of earlier RecordRef objects required below
body_common_fields.study_id: nonempty prospective study identity where study-scoped

common.common_field_exceptions: P uses only its exact listed fields; R0 uses its recorded exact v1 layout. I is a deterministic identity recipe, not a fabricated approval. All other future evidence/approval records require the applicable common fields.

envelope_fields.digest_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical body, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing LF
envelope_fields.identity: declared prefix + first 12 lowercase body-digest hex characters

common.hash_rules: Body hash excludes only the envelope, not arbitrary body fields. Record references bind identity, full body digest, schema/version and raw digest of the complete exact file. Full digests decide equality; short identity suffixes are labels only.
common.identity_prefix_rule: Use the exact identity_prefix listed for each role, plus the first 12 full body-digest hexadecimal characters. I is the deterministic P/source-manifest digest exception described by its recipe; its identity is not an authority record. All comparisons use full digests.
common.independence: Qualifier and each independent verifier must be identified and independent of production of the implementation or evidence they verify; read and reproduce exact bound inputs, not endorse the producing agent receipt.
common.record_role_values: The exact case-sensitive role key in this catalogue is the record_role value; no aliases.
common.rejection: Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, wrong tags/versions, wrong types, booleans as integers, nonfinite numbers, malformed digests, missing required fields and unresolved references. No default authority or implicit PASS.
common.status: Optional descriptive envelope field; never supplies authority. The substantive decision/status is bound in body or a separate approval record.

encoding.character_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; no Unicode normalization
encoding.floats: Only inherited pinned scientific configuration fields may retain finite JSON floats; new arithmetic uses reduced rational strings. No NaN/Infinity.
encoding.raw_digest: SHA256 of exact file bytes; never LF normalize unless inherited pin explicitly says sha256_lf
encoding.record_file: canonical envelope plus exactly one LF; raw hashes include LF

primitive_commitment.recipe: SHA256(domain UTF-8 bytes || exact 32-byte private salt || exact canonical SeedPayload file bytes including LF)
primitive_commitment.salt_creation: Only within separately authorized generation operation after valid full accepted list and active-chain checks; never after terminal cancellation. No salt in drafting or synthetic qualification.

A.acceptance_predicates: Approves only exact bytes and evidence boundary, never inventory count alone.

required_body_fields.approved_scope: exact boundary and all limitation IDs

AuthorityEvent.acceptance_predicates: Serialized exclusive append with durable active-tip compare-and-swap, producer leases/fence epochs and stop evidence. Unknown/stale/forked tips fail closed.
AuthorityEvent.authority: Explicit authorized actor for event kind.

required_body_fields.affected_authorizations: list of existing RecordRef; never future records
required_body_fields.event_kind: ISSUE, CONSUME, HOLD, RELEASE, CONTINUE, REVOKE, TERMINATE or CORRECT

B.acceptance_predicates: Complete read-back of identities, private inventory approvals, 41 packages/82 files/41 defaults, conditions/aliases and unchanged source boundary. No unaccounted intervening matches.

required_body_fields.accounted_qualification: all in-scope consumed values or explicit no-intervening-use evidence

C.acceptance_predicates: Public fields contain only approved IDs/digests/counts/status/text; no seeds, salt, private paths or raw diagnostics. Later receipt is append-only, not inserted into C.
C.authority: Authorized publisher records immutable approved bytes.

CompletedMembershipSupplement.acceptance_predicates: Bind exact immutable complete payload; outside-K newly evidenced history is permissible only after full-list verified non-overlap, not during partial generation. No reseal or retroactive completeness.
CompletedMembershipSupplement.authority: Independent verifier; separate lead continuation before resumed publication/dispatch.

D.acceptance_predicates: Every worker start/retry/finalization rechecks full active tuple, chain and sources. One outcome-blind infrastructure recovery only; same cell/input; all attempts retained.

F.acceptance_predicates: Eligibility true only row 7 plus complete integrity/profile gates. Rows 1–6, cancellation, failure and active hold ineligible. Seal machine record before prose; independently reproduce complete serialization.
F.authority: Independent integrity verifier; authorized final recorder.

required_body_fields.F_D_S_H_statuses: separate registered contrast statuses or NOT EVALUABLE
required_body_fields.approved_inventory_boundary: exact approved K/evidence boundary by opaque refs
required_body_fields.effective_registered_status: historical override first; frozen reporting label/disposition
required_body_fields.historical_integrity: INTACT, HOLD_PENDING_ADJUDICATION, HISTORICAL_OVERLAP, UNRESOLVED_HISTORICAL_INTEGRITY or CANCELLED_PRECOLLECTION
required_body_fields.historical_superiority: registered H interpretation independent of historical non-reuse
required_body_fields.requirement_C: NOT ESTABLISHED or ESTABLISHED in the registered bounded scope with permanent historical non-reuse limitation
required_body_fields.scientific_classification: exact registered computed label or null
required_body_fields.scientific_priority_row: integer 1..7 or null when result NOT PRODUCED

G.acceptance_predicates: Durably consumed once; never reused for a new study or operation. PG-R8 release can continue only the same paused operation.
G.authority: Research lead separately authorizes one study/operation.

required_body_fields.sampling: uint64 OS-CSPRNG eight-byte big-endian; exact K and duplicate rejection; accepted order

GenerationBoundary.acceptance_predicates: Durable write and verified inventory/authority before first raw draw; uncertain ordering is a hold.

I.acceptance_predicates: P changes I; source change changes I. Test-source-only change renews Q even if I is unchanged.

J.acceptance_predicates: No future S/C/F requirement. Preserve original published bytes; append immediate hold notice then disposition/correction. Terminal study cannot resume.
J.authority: Independent integrity verifier; lead release/continuation/revocation; authorized recorder.
dependencies: only S/C/F actually existing at stage

required_body_fields.disposition: hold, release, cancellation, NOT EVALUABLE, invalidation or disclosure

LeadContinuation.acceptance_predicates: Partial draws permitted only independently verified disjoint prefix and all new values in original K, valid audit/bindings and full release chain. No new study or generation operation.
LeadContinuation.authority: Research lead separately authorizes based on independent receipt.

O.acceptance_predicates: No count-based adoption. Intervening qualification, or any K/E/L/provenance/inspection change, reopens O/V/A/R/B.
dependencies: T if applicable; otherwise explicit NOT_APPLICABLE

required_body_fields.known_membership_scope: E6/E8 plus every evidenced in-scope prior qualification value

P.acceptance_predicates: PROPOSED_NOT_FROZEN is not consumable as frozen authority. Later adoption attestation binds exact body and review bytes, outside P digest.
P.authority: Research lead separately freezes exact reviewed body/package; recorder verifies bytes.

required_body_fields.contract_files: path-keyed raw digest map of public rule and schema specifications
required_body_fields.parent_freeze: exact path/identity/digest/sha256_raw ref to original freeze

PartialGenerationSupplement.acceptance_predicates: No S/c/W/U/C dependency. Prefix overlap cancels; any verified outside-K value cancels even when prefix disjoint; otherwise hold or separately authorized same-operation continuation.

required_body_fields.still_incomplete_scope: all unresolved IDs and explicit limitation

PrefixAndKVerification.acceptance_predicates: Source recipe/default alone insufficient. Missing equality, actual-use, scope or temporal evidence stays unresolved; no non-overlap inference.

PrefixSnapshot.acceptance_predicates: Read back exact retained raw bytes; positions contiguous; all rejected raw candidates retained separately; prefix immutable.

required_body_fields.last_acceptance_ordinal: integer or explicit none for empty prefix

Q.acceptance_predicates: Complete amended instrument required; v1 PASS or this preparation validation cannot become v2 PASS. No execution authority.
Q.authority: Independent qualifier; lead accepts exact qualification boundary.

required_body_fields.reference_vectors: qualified synthetic vectors and raw digest

R.acceptance_predicates: R0 is not R. Changed bytes, scope, evidence, A or revocation requires new R; generic waiver invalid.
R.authority: Research lead explicitly accepts specific operational uncertainty.

required_body_fields.accepted_limitation: exact narrowed known-history non-reuse assurance and unresolved scope
required_body_fields.risk: H UNKNOWN; no useful numeric bound; only worst-case bound 1

S.acceptance_predicates: S has no c/W/U/C dependency. All immutable payload/salt/audit bytes verified by W; no altered accepted position or repair under same study.

SeedPayload.acceptance_predicates: Private canonical JSON + one LF; no S/c/W/U/C dependencies and no own raw digest inside payload. Salt separate. No discretionary selection.
SeedPayload.authority: Authorized recorder; independently verified by W.

T.acceptance_predicates: Finish before O seals; absent authorization prohibits matches. Changed Q boundary renews Q/downstream records; otherwise new execution reopens inventory only.
T.authority: Lead separately authorizes matches; independent verifier verifies receipt.

required_body_fields.consumed_values: private exact in-scope values and provenance

U.acceptance_predicates: No actual C digest inside U: C binds U forward. Verifier checks exact template and U insertion, sanitized content and active tuple before publication.
U.authority: Research lead separately authorizes after W.

required_body_fields.approved_public_record_body: exact sanitized proposed C body without self/U ref; template digest with declared U insertion slot

V.acceptance_predicates: PASS requires reproduced exact known-set evidence, including complete E6/E8 inclusion; completeness stays NOT ESTABLISHED. Agent-only membership receipt insufficient.

required_body_fields.reproduced_checks: membership, defaults, derivations, temporal/scope and provenance checks

W.acceptance_predicates: Recompute all private bytes and c; prefix receipt never substitutes. U and C do not exist as prerequisites. Drift/hold/revocation blocks use.

AuditEntry.accepted_position: positive integer for ACCEPT; null otherwise

AuthorityEvent.affected_authorizations: list of existing RecordRef; never future records
AuthorityEvent.event_kind: ISSUE, CONSUME, HOLD, RELEASE, CONTINUE, REVOKE, TERMINATE or CORRECT

InventoryStatus.inspection_boundary: opaque scope statement and ArtifactRef evidence

Position.value_hex: exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters; private uint64
